left_definition: Other-user comments: at least one single comment both explicitly quotes specific OP wording and refutes a factual claim in that quoted OP text.
left_spec: Read title, argument (OP text) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP; parse it). Return 1 if at least one single comment both (a) explicitly quotes or directly reproduces specific wording from the OP's title/argument (endorsement not required; quotation marks alone do not suffice unless the text matches the OP text) and (b) refutes, in that same comment, a factual claim contained in that quoted OP wording by arguing it is factually wrong. Quotation and refutation must be in the same comment and concern the same OP factual claim; separate comments cannot satisfy it. Refuting only opinions/values, or quoting without refuting, or refuting without quoting, gives 0. Use current supplied text including marked edits, but ignore as evidence any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even inside argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement. Return 0 for a valid empty comment list with available OP text; null if OC_comments is missing/malformed, or if OP title/argument is missing so that absence cannot be established (a positive match may still be 1). List order carries no meaning. Output one 0/1 or null.
right_definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment explicitly challenges the OP's underlying assumptions or premises, not merely disputing the OP's factual conclusions.
right_spec: Read title and argument (OP's view, as context for identifying the OP's underlying assumptions) and OC_comments (JSON list of comments by other users, not the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly challenges an underlying assumption, premise or framing that the OP's view rests on (e.g. questions a presupposed value, definition, or unstated premise), as opposed to only disputing the OP's factual claims or conclusions. A comment that disputes assumptions as well as conclusions counts. Quoted text counts only if the commenter themself adopts the challenge. Return 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does this, and 0 for a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed, or if OP title/argument context is missing so the OP's assumptions cannot be identified. Ignore and do not use as evidence any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use supplied current text including marked edits; do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Output a single 0/1 or null per row.

Return 1 if at least one comment, in its own voice, explicitly quantifies systemic material harm to third parties: it gives specific numeric or magnitude-based figures (e.g. counts, percentages, monetary amounts, rates, scale of people affected) for material harms (e.g. economic, health, physical, loss of resources or life) that fall on people other than the OP and the commenter and that arise from systems, institutions, policies or widespread practices. A comment that only asserts a proposition is false/incorrect, gives qualitative or unquantified harm claims, or cites only individual/personal harm without systemic scope does not qualify. Quantification must be part of the comment's own argument; harms mentioned only in text it quotes from someone else and does not adopt do not count. Return 0 if the list is valid and no comment qualifies, including a valid empty list. Return null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; do not use them as evidence. Generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and may be considered if relevant. Output one value: 1, 0 or null.
right_definition: Other-user comments: at least one comment uses second-person direct address (e.g., you/your) aimed at the original poster.
right_spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment uses second-person direct address to the original poster, i.e., 'you/your/you're/yourself' referring to the OP or the OP's view, statements, or situation. Return 0 if no comment does so; generic 'you' meaning people in general, 'you' inside quotations attributed to someone else directed at third parties, and 'you' addressing other commenters do not count. Ignore any text reporting the OP's view change, delta awards, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or other outcome reporting; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is neither counted as an announcement nor excluded. Use the supplied current text; do not infer timing or order. A valid empty list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. Output a single 0/1.
